findings.title: Duplicate page: pages 43 and 44 look like the same page
findings.detail: The two page images match closely (correlation 0.999) and 83% of their words are shared. Separate scans of the same sheet are never byte-identical, so this is judged from how they look. It is a lead: consecutive forms of the same kind can look alike.
